description_en: Retrieves information about a user's issued bills, including billing cycles, consumption time, metering peak values, and service types
description_zh: 获取用户已出账单的消费周期、消费时间、计量峰值数值、业务类型等信息
name: GetBalanceBandwidthData

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400. Unit: seconds.

If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value 300 is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，支持300、3600、14400、28800和86400秒。

不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: data_interval

parameters.help_en: The resource ID of the current bill
parameters.name: resource_id
